grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.speaker: Mistag
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.text: I'm sorry, but surface goblins are not allowed into the city.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.player: Grubfoot? What are you doing here?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.text: [player name]! I so glad you here! You help me get into Dorgesh-city? I want talk to Chosen Commander.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.text: Yes, that her. I have dream about her, remember, before you come to Goblin Village. She Chosen Commander who lead all goblins to new age.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.text: Generals still not sure, but Grubfoot sure. She Chosen Commander!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.player: Mistag, why won't you let Grubfoot into the city?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.speaker: Mistag
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.text: Our laws don't currently allow surface goblins to enter. The council wants to extend a hand of friendship to their kind, but we have heard that they are a very warlike people.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-mis.prompt: Start the Land of the Goblins quest?

steps.player: I'll take responsibility for Grubfoot. I know he won't cause any trouble.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Hmm... If you are prepared to vouch for him, then I suppose we can trust him.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Very well, Grubfoot. You may enter Dorgesh-Kaan, but you must stay with [player name] until you leave.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Thank you, [player name]! I promise I be no trouble.

steps.player: I think I'll let you two sort this out yourselves.

grubfoot-s-dream-walking-with-grubfoot-w.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-walking-with-grubfoot-w.text: Hello, [player name]! Will you take me into Dorgesh-city now?

steps.text: If the player has a pet following them:

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: I follow you, but you should pick up pet thingy first.

options.text: I don't have time right now.

steps.player: I don't have time right now.

grubfoot-s-dream-walking-with-grubfoot-w.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-walking-with-grubfoot-w.text: Will you take me into Dorgesh-city now?

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Okay. I go back to wait in Dorgesh-mines.

grubfoot-s-dream-walking-with-grubfoot-i.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-walking-with-grubfoot-i.text: I want go into Dorgesh-city, not go that way. I meet you back at Dorgesh mines.

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

grubfoot-s-dream-walking-with-grubfoot-i.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-walking-with-grubfoot-i.text: You talk to her for me, [player name]! I too nervous!

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Guard
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: What are you doing in the city, surface goblin?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: I looking for Chosen Commander!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Guard
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Commander of the guard?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Guard
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Zanik's not any kind of commander. She'd never fit into a command structure, she's too independant.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Guard
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Anyway, I think I saw her with Oldak earlier. You should check his lab.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Guard
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: A surface goblin in the city? That's against the rules!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.player: Mistag said that Grubfoot could come in as long as he stayed with me.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Guard
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Hmm... Carry on, then. But I'm keeping an eye on you.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Guard
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: I'm keeping an eye on you, surface gobiln.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: I not make any trouble!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: What happened to your eyes?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Nothing wrong with my eyes.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.player: Grubfoot is a goblin from the surface. They all have eyes that size.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Oh! Welcome to the city, surface goblin! What are you doing down here?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: I looking for Chosen Commander.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Zanik? She's no commander... I think she's in Oldak's lab at the moment.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Eek! A goblin!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Yes, but a goblin from the surface...

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: I not mean any harm. Just here to see Chosen Commander.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Chosen Commander?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Zanik? I should hope that fool isn't in command of anything!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Hello?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Where is Chosen Commander?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Who?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Yes. Zanik is Chosen Commander.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Oh? Chosen by whom?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Big High War God! He choose Zanik to lead all goblins into new age!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Cave goblin
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: The war god? Oh no!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.player: It's okay! Zanik isn't in league with any war god.
Grubfoot, you probably shouldn't mention the Big High War God down here. He's not exactly popular with the Dorgeshuun.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Ur-tag
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: A surface goblin? What are you doing in the city?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Miner person say I can come in.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.player: Mistag said that Grubfoot could come into the city as long as he stayed with me.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Ur-tag
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: That is somewhat irregular, but I suppose it is reasonable. Welcome to the city, surface goblin! What brings you to Dorgesh-Kaan?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: I looking for Chosen Commander.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.speaker: Ur-tag
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-cave-goblins.text: Ah yes, of course. I think she has been helping Oldak with his experiments recently. You should check Oldak's lab.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak.player: Hello, Zanik! There's someone here to see you.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak.text: Remarkable! You must be a goblin from the surface, correct?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak.speaker: Zanik
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak.text: I recognize you. You were in Goblin Village, weren't you? You said you had a dream about me.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak.text: Yes. You Chosen Commander. Other goblins not believe, but I believe.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: They say Zanik not true goblin. She cannot be Chosen Commander because she not worship Big High War God. Because she not think war good.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I certainly don't!

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: But does that mean she have no destiny? Perhaps her destiny to lead goblins into new age of peace.

options.text: That's an unusual sentiment for a goblin.

steps.player: That's an unusual sentiment for a goblin.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Yes. I thought all surface goblins thought war was good.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Most do, but not me. I see goblins kill goblins, humans kill goblins. I think, is this really best thing in life?

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: I not say that to other goblins. They kill me if they think I not like war.

options.text: So why have you come to talk to Zanik?
So why have you come to talk to Zanik?

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Goblin legend. Hopespear, long ago goblin, he have dream. He say someday Chosen Commander come, lead all goblins to new age.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Most goblins, they think Chosen Commander lead goblins to war and fight other races. But I think maybe not.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: I have dreams that Zanik is Chosen Commander. Before you visit Goblin Village I dream about Zanik. And now, last night I have new dream.

options.text: So why have you come to talk to Zanik?

steps.player: So why have you come to talk to Zanik?

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: To tell Chosen Commander about new dream I have.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Yes, what was it?
Cutscene begins, showing a distant, lush, foreign land with goblins.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: I have dream of far-off land. It like no land I ever see, but somehow I know it.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: It cool and wet. Ground is soft, big plants everywhere, red water bubbling.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: I see goblins, many goblins. Goblins of all tribes, but they not fight. They have no weapons. They live in peace.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Then I see Chosen Commander. She stand at entrance to new land, she show way in. She lead all goblins on long journey to new land.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: I never see land before. I see it only in dream. But somehow I know what it is. It Yu'biusk, Land of the Goblins.
Cutscene ends.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: That goblin legend. Land of Goblins. Legend say long ago, even before war of gods, goblins come from Yu'biusk. Big High War God find them in Yu'biusk and take them to other lands.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: Most goblins forget legend. Think only of war. But I think, if Zanik lead us back to Yu'biusk, maybe we have peace. Maybe we be safe from people who want to kill us.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.player: How do you know your dream was true?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: Yes, how do you know? Dorgeshuun scientists and philosophers generally believe that dreams are a way for the mind to sort through memories. There is no known mechanism by which they can predict the future.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: This dream not like other dream. It so real.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Zanik
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: What do you think, [player name]?

options.text: It's just a dream. It doesn't mean anything.

steps.player: It's just a dream. It doesn't mean anything.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: It not just dream! It true! I know in heart!

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: I'm sorry, Grubfoot, but wanting something badly doesn't make it true.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Even so... if there's any chance there might be something in it, we have to investigate.

options.text: I think it must mean something.

steps.player: I think it must mean something.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Thank you, [player name]! I know you believe me!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: It's probably nothing, but if there's even a small chance there's something in it, we have to investigate.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Zanik
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: So where is this promised land, Grubfoot?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: I not know. Not know any goblin who know. But...

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Zanik
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: But what?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: I should not tell! Not in front of non-goblin!

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Zanik
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: [player name] is a friend. You can tell [him/her/them].

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: I suppose...

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: There secret place. Secret temple to Big High War God. No one know of it but goblins. Priests in secret temple, I bet they know way to Yu'biusk.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: But before I tell you where temple is, you must make promise. Promise not to tell any other non-goblins where temple is. If humans find out, maybe they attack, kill all goblins in temple.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Zanik
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: I promise, Grubfoot. I won't tell anyone where the temple is.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: If that is what is required to keep your temple safe, then I promise too.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: [player name], you must promise as well. That very important.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.player: I promise not to tell anyone where the temple is.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: I trust you, [player name]. You save village from H.A.M. attack. Now I tell you where temple is.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: It built long ago, on Plain of Mud. It sink into mud and now it underground in muddy caves. It far west of here, near place where many humans catch fish.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: Hmm... I've heard of a cave system to the west where many goblins live. That must be where this temple is hidden. I can make teleport spheres to take you there.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: I can't go. I must get back to village before generals miss me.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: Oh, that's a pity. Just a minute...

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: Here, break this sphere on the ground. It will take you back to the Goblin Village.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: Thank you. I go now, but you must go to temple and find way to Yu'biusk.
Grubfoot teleports away.

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: [player name], Zanik, are you ready to leave?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.speaker: Zanik
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-zanik-oldak-.text: I'm ready!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Then let's go!
Zanik and the player teleport to the Goblin Cave.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I'll wait until you are, [player name].

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-oldak-again-.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-oldak-again-.text: Hello, [player name]. What did you find in the Goblin Temple?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-oldak-again-.speaker: Oldak
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-oldak-again-.text: Ah, well you'd better get back there then.

options.text: Can you teleport me to the temple again?
Can I buy a teleport sphere please?

grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-bef.speaker: Grubfoot
grubfoot-s-dream-talking-to-grubfoot-bef.text: Did you go to Land of Goblins?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-zanik.text: The entrance to the secret temple must be around here somewhere, [player name].

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Okay, [player name]. I'll meet you back at the cave entrance.

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.speaker: Goblin guard (1)
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.text: Me hear Dorgesh tribe return from below ground.

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.speaker: Goblin guard (2)
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.text: You want get into temple, Dorgesh-goblin?

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.speaker: Goblin guard (2)
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.text: Human! Where you think you going?

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.player: But you said we could go in!

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.speaker: Goblin guard (1)
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.text: No, we say Dorgesh-goblin go in. You human, you go away!

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.speaker: Goblin guard (2)
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.text: Humans not allowed! Only goblins allowed!

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.speaker: Goblin guard (2)
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.text: Go away, human! We already tell you not to come in!

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.speaker: Goblin guard (1)
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-goblin.text: Only goblins allowed in. If you goblin, you come in. But you not goblin, you stupid stinky puny human.

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.text: Hello, [player name]. What did you find in the Goblin Temple?

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.player: Humans aren't allowed inside. They let Zanik in, but not me.

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.text: Hmm... that is an interesting problem. But I think there is a way to get you in.

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.player: How can I get into the temple without being a goblin?
What? But you said you had a way.

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.text: Yes, I think you can get into the temple, but not without being a goblin. I have been in correspondence with some of the wizards who live on the surface. I know of one who might be able to help you.

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak.text: They are known as the Makeover Mage. You should go and talk to them. I believe they live south west of the human city of Falador.

options.text: Can you teleport me to the temple again?

steps.player: Can you teleport me to the temple again?

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: I can, but I can't afford to keep doing it for free. If you get me two law runes and a piece of molten glass, I'll make a sphere to take you there.
If the player does not have the materials:

steps.player: I'll have to go get some law runes and molten glass then.

steps.text: If the player has the materials:
The player is teleported to the Goblin Cave.

options.text: Can I buy a teleport sphere please?
I'll go and see this mage.

steps.player: I'll go and see this mage.

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak-.speaker: Oldak
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak-.text: Hello, [player name]. Did you speak to the Makeover Mage?

imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak-.speaker: Oldak
imposter-among-goblins-talking-to-oldak-.text: You really should. I believe they live south west of the human city of Falador.

options.text: Can you teleport me to the temple again?
Can I buy a teleport sphere please?
I'll go and see this mage.

steps.text: You not understand Big High War God at all! You like filthy stinking cave goblin! Go away and think on how stupid you are!

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: It true that prophet Hopespear tell us goblin should not fight against goblin. But Big High War God, he command that those who not believe must die.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: To little mind, weak mind, this seem to contradict. But only if you not have faith. In Big High War God, there no contradiction.

options.text: We try to convert them instead.

steps.player: We try to convert them instead.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Convert them? You stupid goblin! You not even know name of god. He Big High WAR God! We kill enemies, not convert!

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: That good. True goblin not want to understand. Fight and die for glory of Big High War God. Never ask question or have thought.

steps.player: Me want to know about Yu'biusk.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Yu'biusk is goblin legend. Very old legend, from before this temple built. From before Hopespear the prophet. Even before great war.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Legend say that goblins come from land of Yu'biusk. Big High War God find goblins in Yu'biusk and bring them to other lands to train them as warriors!

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Why we want to return to Yu'biusk? In Yu'biusk we weak. Big High War God take us from Yu'biusk and make us strong.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Me not know. Me think Snothead maybe know.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: He old high priest in temple crypt behind me! He dead!

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Maybe me ask him next time me see him.

steps.player: What? But you said he dead!

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Ha ha! You not know, but since you pass test, me tell you.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: When goblin high priest die, they buried in temple crypt in special magic way.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: This mean next high priest can ask them questions, even though they dead. I just say name of high priest over grave, and he appear and answer questions.

options.text: Can I talk to old high priests?

steps.player: Can I talk to old high priests?

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: No. Temple crypt is holy place. Only high priest allowed into crypt, and that me. No other goblin ever go in.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Crypt door locked by six keys, kept by six tribal priests. Priests only give keys to me. They never give them to normal goblin like you.

options.text: What Big High War God's real name?
Why there only six tribes in temple?
What Big High War God's real name?
Why there only six tribes in temple?

steps.player: What Big High War God's real name?

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: You ask big question. Big High War God's true name not for normal goblin minds, but since you pass test, I tell you. His true name Bandos.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: That name that ogres call him, that orks call him. That name that goblin priests call him on holy days. But normal goblins, you must show respect. You only call him Big High War God.

options.text: Why there only six tribes in temple?

steps.player: Why there only six tribes in temple?

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Goblin tribes are thing of past. Long ago, all goblins divided into twelve tribes. Dorgeshuun tribe rebel, so Big High War God punish them. Then there eleven tribes.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: No other tribes disappear like Dorgeshuun, but over ages, tribes merge. Now most goblins, they not know what tribe they come from.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Sometimes, goblins who know what tribe they come from, they come here and make tribal enclaves. They colour armour different colours to show what tribe they in. But not all tribes here.

options.text: How me get into tribal enclaves?

steps.player: How me get into tribal enclaves?

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Goblins show tribe by dying armour special tribe colour. Yellow for Yurkolgokh, white for Saragorgak, purple for Horogothgar, orange for Narogoshuun, blue for Ekeleshuun and black for Huzamogaarb.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: You not wearing colour, you not entering the enclave.

steps.speaker: High Priest Bighead
steps.text: Some goblins say they go to witch-lady in Draynor for it. Me hope they beat up witch-lady and take dye! That way of Big High War God!

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Usually you can't, but with poorly-made clothes, it's possible to remove the dye. Even then, it's a very tricky process involving a special ingredient found in the gut of the Hemenster Whitefish.

steps.speaker: Aggie

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: If you fancy catching some, you should know that very specific bait is needed. Only slimy eels will work. I hear you can catch those in the caves below Lumbridge Swamp.

steps.speaker: Aggie

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Listen! Whoever does not worship Big High War God, whether great or small, goblin or other, must die!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: If another goblin tell you to worship different gods, you not listen to them! You kill them! All tribe kill them!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Kill peoples who worship different gods! Smite them! Destroy them! Do not show mercy!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Enemies must die! Doubters must die! These words of Big High War God!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Remember, we holy people of Big High War God! He chose us to be special people, better than all people in world!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Big High War God not choose us because we many, or because we strong. We nothing before he choose us! But he take us from Yu'biusk with mighty hand, and make us strong!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Soon Big High War God send Chosen Commander!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: I tell you truth! There some goblins here who not die before they see Chosen Commander coming with glory of Big High War God!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Then Chosen Commander lead goblins into war as one army, and we kill every other race and all followers of other gods!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Then Big High War God himself return and sit on throne of bronze and rull over all!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Let me tell you story about Hopespear! He prophet of Big High War God! He very holy goblin!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: When Hopespear old, he walking near Goblin Village, and little goblin children came out of village and make fun of him.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: The he look at them, and curse them in name of Big High War God. Then monsters come and tear children to pieces!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: May Big High War God give you faith!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Before you enter battle, clear mind of thought. Do not think about what you will do or what may happen.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: When battle start, Big High War God guide your arm and fill your heart with courage.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Have faith in Big High War God. He rule all war, so whatever happen in war, it his will.

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Goblins great nation in time of great war!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Big High War God himself lead us into battle! Then we crush enemies, we burn cities to ground, we kill every man, woman and child! Even animals!

keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.speaker: Priest
keys-to-the-crypt-talking-to-the-tribe-p.text: Some enemies, we kill them so bad, now there no trace and no one ever remember them! That what happen to enemies of Big High War God!

high-priests-of-ages-past-snothead.speaker: Snothead
high-priests-of-ages-past-snothead.text: You beat me. What you want?

steps.speaker: Snothead
steps.text: It long way away. Me not know where. High priest who come before me, he say that when goblins die we go to Yu'biusk. Perhaps he know where it is.

steps.speaker: Snothead
steps.text: Snailfeet. That his name.

steps.speaker: Snothead
steps.text: You not goblin. Not high priest. So me attack.

steps.speaker: Snothead
steps.text: It dark. Very dark. And cold.

high-priests-of-ages-past-snailfeet.speaker: Snailfeet
high-priests-of-ages-past-snailfeet.text: You beaten me. Ask your questions.

steps.speaker: Snailfeet
steps.text: Far, far away. Me not know where. But high priest who come before me, he say that when goblins die in battle, our souls travel to Yu'biusk.

steps.speaker: Snailfeet
steps.text: Mosschin.

steps.speaker: Snailfeet
steps.text: You not goblin high priest! Me only answer questions for goblin high priest!

steps.speaker: Snailfeet
steps.text: Why me here? Me die in battle, fighting humans! Why me not in Yu'biusk?

high-priests-of-ages-past-mosschin.speaker: Mosschin
high-priests-of-ages-past-mosschin.text: You have defeated me, human. Ask your questions.

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: Far beyond this world. Long ago, the Big High War God brought goblins from Yu'biusk.

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: The high priest who came before me said that whenever goblins die in battle and their blood spills onto the ground, Yu'biusk is close and their souls can travel there.

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: Redeyes.

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: I only answer questions for those who are worthy! I had to test you!

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: All alone. I thought my soul would travel to Yu'biusk. But perhaps I was not worthy.

steps.speaker: Mosschin
steps.text: Goodbye, human.

high-priests-of-ages-past-redeyes.speaker: Redeyes
high-priests-of-ages-past-redeyes.text: You have defeated me, human. Ask your questions.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: Yu'biusk is far away. Beyond the icelands to the north, beyond the mountains to the west, beyond the oceans to the south and the deserts to the east.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: But it is also close. Wherever goblins fight in the name of the Big High War God and their blood spills on the ground, Yu'biusk is close.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: My predecessor told me that no living goblin has ever gone to Yu'biusk. If no living goblin can go there, then perhaps the dead can.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: Strongbones. He was a mighty high priest and warrior of the Big High War God. It was he who learned the magic that allows us to be called up to speak with the living.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: You are not a goblin high priest, so I had to see if you were worthy.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: I had thought perhaps I would go to Yu'biusk, to fight in endless battles for the Big High War God. Instead, there is only endless sleep.

steps.speaker: Redeyes
steps.text: Good luck in your quest, human.

high-priests-of-ages-past-strongbones.speaker: Strongbones
high-priests-of-ages-past-strongbones.text: You have proved yourself the stronger, human. Ask your questions.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: Yu'biusk is another plane of existence. No goblin alive today has ever been there.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: It is many millennia since the Big High War God brought our ancestors from Yu'biusk, but the call to that plane is still strong in us.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: If the barriers between the planes were ever to be broken, goblin blood would call out and open a portal to Yu'biusk.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: His name is not important. He is not buried here. Before my time, priests were cremated, and their ashes scattered to the winds. You cannot talk to him.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: You are a human, not one of the children of the Big High War God. For this reason, you had to prove yourself in combat before I could speak with you.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: I cannot tell you. I no longer remember what it is like to be alive.

steps.speaker: Strongbones
steps.text: Goodbye, human. I am sure that the Chosen Commander will find what she is looking for when you bring her to Yu'biusk.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: You're back! Any luck at the temple? Have you found out where Yu'biusk is?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.player: Sort of. I've discovered that Yu'biusk is another plane of existence. Apparently if the barriers between the planes are breached, goblin blood will call out to Yu'biusk and create a portal leading there.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Another plane? You mean goblins aren't native to Gielinor? That's remarkable. Think of the historical implications...

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.player: But how could we breach the barriers between the planes?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: I know! The fungus ring in the southern caves! Didn't you say that had magical properties, Oldak?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Yes... that sample you showed me had very similar properties to Law runes. I believe that the fungus ring could create an effect similar to my moving-over-distance spheres.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.player: Fungus ring? That sounds like a fairy ring. They're part of a big teleportation network.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Well that confirms it then. This fungus ring might be just what we need!

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: If the ring can create a moving-over-distance effect... then with enough power, we should be able to use it to break the planar barriers.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Then we just need goblin blood to call out to Yu'biusk!

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Well I reckon we've got plenty of that.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: I can't believe this! The goblin homeland! This could be somewhere safe for goblins like Grubfoot. A new home, free of war!

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Could this be it, [player name]? Could this be my destiny? Could this be why I was marked by the Tears of Guthix?

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: We should see if this works before we tell anyone else. Now, I think I can create some apparatus to provide power to the fungus ring.

path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-returning-to-dorgesh-ka.text: Come on, Zanik. [player name], will you meet us by the fungus ring to the south of the city?

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.text: Hey, [player name]. This is incredible! I can't believe we're really going to go to Yu'biusk, the Land of the Goblins!

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.player: What do you think we'll find there?

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.text: I don't know. All we have to go on is Grubfoot's dream, which isn't much. Still, not long now until we find out!

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-zanik.text: Anyway, you should help Oldak out with the machine. He wants me to stand here so that when the portal opens, it'll have a goblin right next to it.

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.text: Ah, [player name]. The machine is nearly ready. When I activate it, it will bombard the fungus ring with magical energy.

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.text: For this to work, we'll need to make sure the power is distributed correctly between the three circles of fungi. I need to handle the activation. [player name], could you please handle the power distribution?

path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
path-to-yu-biusk-talking-to-oldak.text: The inner circle has a radius of one zurg, the middle circle has a radius of two zurgs, and the outer circle has a radius of three zurgs. You will need to distribute the power in proportion to the area of each circle.

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: The screen fades to black. The player, Zanik, and Oldak arrive at a barren wasteland.

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: Something must have gone wrong. This isn't what Grubfoot described.

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: I don't understand. What happened here?

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: We must be missing something. This can't be it...

through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-activating-the-m.text: I'll stay here and keep an eye on the portal.

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.text: You should have a look around and see if you can find out anything about this place. I'll stay here and keep an eye on the portal.

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.text: [player name]. We should head back through the portal. Zanik is waiting on the other side.

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-oldak.text: Don't go too far! I don't know how stable this portal is!

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-zanik.text: There must be something around here. It can't all be dead... can it?

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-grubf.speaker: Grubfoot
through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-grubf.text: Did you go to Land of Goblins?

through-the-fungus-ring-talking-to-grubf.player: Yes, but we haven't properly explored it yet.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: This is really it, isn't it? Grubfoot's dream was just that, a dream. All Yu'biusk is now is an empty wasteland.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.player: I don't understand... What happened here?

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: The Big High War God happened.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: I thought this might be it, [player name]. I really did. I thought this place might finally give me some answers, but it's just another dead end.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Zanik
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: Let's have a look at what this box is, then let's go home. There's nothing here for anyone any more.
The player and Zanik push off the cover of the strange box. Suddenly, Zanik is surrounded by energy emanating from the box.
Zanik is sucked into the strange box.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: The portal is closing! You've got to get back now!
The player quickly returns to Oldak.

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: [player name]? What's going on? Where's Zanik?

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.player: I don't know... She just disappeared...

through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.speaker: Oldak
through-the-fungus-ring-a-strange-box.text: The portal... We have to go.
The player enters the portal, arriving back at Oldak's lab.

options.text: What are we going to do about Zanik?
options.condition: If the player has not yet traveled to Yu'biusk via fairy ring:

steps.player: What are we going to do about Zanik?

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: We can only assume she's still in Yu'biusk somewhere. Problem is, I haven't been able to get the fungus ring machine working again.

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: Perhaps not. Still, now that we've broken the planar barriers between Gielinor and Yu'biusk, maybe we've enabled some alternate methods of transport there.

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: Those fungus rings would be a good starting point. Maybe you could use one of them to find another way to Yu'biusk. In the meantime, I'll keep trying to get the machine working again.

options.text: I managed to get back to Yu'biusk.
options.condition: If the player has traveled to Yu'biusk via fairy ring:

steps.player: I managed to get back to Yu'biusk.

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: You did? Did you find anything there? Was there any trace of Zanik?

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: Then it's just as I feared. It seems that whatever's happened to Zanik, wherever she is... she's on her own.

steps.speaker: Oldak
steps.text: I know you will, [player name].

options.text: Can I buy a teleport sphere please?

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.speaker: Grubfoot
post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.text: Did you go to Land of Goblins?

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.player: Yes, but it wasn't how you'd dreamed. It was a devastated wasteland.

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.speaker: Grubfoot
post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.text: Yu'biusk... Land of Goblins... All gone?

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.player: I'm afraid so. And that's not all. Zanik vanished there.
Yes. A bright white light picked her up and then she was gone.

post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.speaker: Grubfoot
post-quest-dialogue-grubfoot.text: She not gone. I sure of it. Someday she return.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!
